plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai selector for the 'Developers' nav menu resolved to the 'Solutions' dropdown, preventing navigation to /docs/ and causing the subsequent URL assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: Cached page.ai script used positional selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' which matched the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
Failure screenshot shows the 'Solutions' dropdown opened on the homepage (https://www.checklyhq.com/) while 'Developers' is visible adjacent to it in the header.
The test failed at assertion expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/') because the browser never navigated away from the home page.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the deterministic Page.AI cache for tests/checkly.test.ts and re-run the test to allow autonomous rediscovery of the 'Developers' dropdown and 'Documentation' link.

plan.notes: The live page still contains the 'Developers' navigation item in the top header. Invalidating the deterministic page.ai cache will allow the autonomous agent to re-target the correct element.
